mapper.sql: id, stock_id, buy_price, buy_count, commission, transfer_fee, handling_fee, regulatory_fee, t_type, t_profit, cost_change, t_group_id, DATE_FORMAT(buy_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS buy_date_str, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at_str
mapper.select: SELECT FROM buy_records WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} ORDER BY buy_date ASC, created_at ASC
SELECT FROM buy_records WHERE stock_id IN #{item} ORDER BY buy_date ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO buy_records (id, stock_id, buy_date, buy_price, buy_count, commission, transfer_fee, handling_fee, regulatory_fee, t_type, t_profit, cost_change, t_group_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{stockId}, #{buyDate}, #{buyPrice}, #{buyCount}, #{commission}, #{transferFee}, #{handlingFee}, #{regulatoryFee}, #{tType}, #{tProfit}, #{costChange}, #{tGroupId})
